_comment: A DELTA on SparkUser, which MintPlayer.Spark.Authorization ships (composition D6), anchored by
$extends (D28): it states only what QnA changes, and never an id. The type itself (breadcrumb
{UserName}, the one UserName attribute) is the library's.
QnA shows UserName on the form only: Question/Answer CreatedBy and ModifiedBy render the user name
through the breadcrumb, and no query lists users.
security.json grants Read/SparkUser to visitors and signed-in users (MCP PRD D19, 2026-10-12: a
reference is shown only to a caller who may Read its target type). QnA's Actions/SparkUserActions
row rule limits it to authors of a published question or a live answer, so it never publishes
every user; anyone else renders the placeholder. Only UserName is in the model.
